$comment: Listing metadata, applied by scripts/store-metadata.mjs in CI (manager/rules/SEO.md). Add actorId here after the first deploy creates the actor, so CI updates it by ID and a rename of name in actor.json keeps the same actor.
seoTitle: Instahyre Jobs Scraper - Experience, Skills & Dates
seoDescription: Scrape Instahyre jobs by skill, city and experience, newest first: posting date, experience range, skills, headcount and stipend. No login or API key.
defaultRunOptions$comment: Default 512 MB, measured locally on 2026-11-08 (apify run, engine from the platform/instahyre branch): the example input took 85 s with a peak of 78 MB and 1.6 s of CPU; a search with details 177 s, 76 MB, 2.3 s CPU. Runs wait on Instahyre's limits (20 searches a minute, about 1.5 job answers a second), not on CPU or memory, so more memory does not make them faster. minMemoryMbytes 256. Re-measure on Apify after the first push (time at 256, 512 and 1024 MB, the daily test input, platform usage).

pricing.$comment: 2026-11-08. Rule: rules/SEO.md section 16. Main competitor: getascraper/instahyre-jobs-scraper, the most used Instahyre actor (326 u30): $0.00105 a job on FREE, $0.0001 more for its detail enrichment (description, experience), $0.00005 start, no posting date. job is 5% under its job and has the experience range and date on every row; job-details is 4% under its enriched row and adds the company page (industry, website, LinkedIn, Glassdoor ratings). Others: memo23 $0.0015 + $0.0015 details + $0.0001 start (81 u30), s_actors $0.000768 + $0.001 start (6), themineworks $0.002 + $0.005 start (6), parsebird $0.00099 + $0.0007 details + $0.001 start (6). Run start $0.001 per GB: a walk first finds the newest job (about 30 answers, 20 s), which a 1-job run would not pay for. Margin (owner: platform cost under 10% of 0.8 x price at every tier), local measurements at 512 MB and $0.20 per CU: 100 rows 97%, 100 rows with details 95%, 1 row with the start fee 88%; re-measure on Apify. Gentle ladder per the owner's decision of 2026-10-29. apply true; isPublic stays false until the priced proof run.

job.eventDescription: One saved job row: title, company, city, experience range, skills, job category, posting date, link, and the company's headcount and founding year. Also one checked job link that is closed or not found.

job-details.eventDescription: One saved job row with full details on: everything in a Job row plus the description as text and HTML, and the company's industry, website, LinkedIn, tech stack, benefits and Glassdoor ratings when Instahyre shows them.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged by Apify when a run starts: once up to 1 GB of memory and once more for each extra GB, so $0.001 at the default 512 MB. It pays for finding Instahyre's newest job, which every run that reads the newest jobs does first.
